cookbooks.title: Getting Started with OpenAI + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Connect to Valkey, create a JSON vector index, store documents, and run your first KNN vector search with OpenAI embeddings.

cookbooks.title: Vector Search with OpenAI + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Combine a TAG pre-filter with KNN for hybrid search, and use the HNSW index for fast approximate search on larger datasets.
